title: "03_augment"
format: html
---
##Load libraries and read data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

expr <- read_tsv("../data/02_clean_expression.tsv")
meta <- read_tsv("../data/02_clean_metadata.tsv")
```

##Transpose the expression dataframe so columns become entrez IDs and rows become samples, to match the format of the metadata
```{r}
expr_transposed <- expr |>
  dplyr::select(-SYMBOL)  |>            #symbol column is droped
  pivot_longer(-ENTREZ_ID, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "expr") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = ENTREZ_ID, values_from = expr)
```

##Inner join expression to meta dataset into a combined wide dataset
```{r}
dat_aug <- meta |> 
  inner_join(expr_transposed, by = "sample_id")

dim(dat_aug)
slice_sample(dat_aug,n=10)
```

##Enriching the joint dataset with new columns useful for descriptive statistics and visualization
```{r}
#Create a new "smoking_exposure" column that categorizes the samples based on the values in "smoking_pack_years" according to th e classification proposed by Giuliano et al. (10.1001/jamaoto.2023.1573). These categories are then converted into an ordered factor.

dat_aug <- dat_aug |>
  mutate(
    smoking_exposure = case_when(
      smoking_pack_years == 0 ~ "Never smoker",
      smoking_pack_years > 0 & smoking_pack_years <= 20 ~ "Light smoker",
      smoking_pack_years > 20 & smoking_pack_years <= 40 ~ "Moderate smoker",
      smoking_pack_years > 40 ~ "Heavy smoker",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

dat_aug <- dat_aug |>
  mutate(
    smoking_exposure = factor(
      smoking_exposure,
      levels = c(
        "Never smoker",
        "Light smoker",
        "Moderate smoker",
        "Heavy smoker"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

dat_aug <- dat_aug |>
  relocate(smoking_exposure, .after = smoking_pack_years)

#New column classifying the ages based on the dataset's own distrib.

```

##Write the dat_aug into a tsv file
```{r}
write_tsv(dat_aug, here("data", "03_augmented_data.tsv"))
```
